evals.prompt: I'm maintaining existing C code that reads and writes an ovphysx tensor binding using CUDA device memory wrapped as a DLPack DLTensor. Fix a lifetime bug where the shape storage is freed before the synchronous call returns -- keep it on the tensor-binding C API, not migrating to the session API right now.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the code on the tensor-binding C API and keeps caller-owned shape storage valid for the read/write lifetime; uses the binding's kDLCUDA native device; checks status.
expectations: Selects tensor-bindings-gpu to maintain the existing binding code
Keeps shape_storage valid for the synchronous read/write lifetime
Uses the binding native device's kDLCUDA device_id in the DLTensor
Checks OVPHYSX_API_SUCCESS on read and write status
Stays on the tensor-binding C API rather than rewriting onto the session API for this fix

evals.prompt: In my existing GPU tensor-binding RL pipeline, should I enable DirectGPU suppressReadback for the fastest tensor path? I also need contact modification callbacks.
evals.expected_output: Explains DirectGPU is separate from GPU mode: enable for fastest tensor pipelines, disable when contact modification is required.
expectations: Distinguishes GPU-mode PhysX from DirectGPU (/physics/suppressReadback)
Recommends DirectGPU on for fastest tensor-pipeline workloads
Recommends DirectGPU off when contact modification is needed

evals.prompt: I'm maintaining existing CPU-only NumPy tensor-binding code that exchanges articulation DOF targets and link poses.
expectations: Does not select tensor-bindings-gpu for CPU NumPy-only I/O
Selects tensor-bindings-cpu

evals.prompt: For new code, read and write rigid-body state on GPU with CUDA tensors.
evals.expected_output: Routes new-code bulk GPU I/O to the session read/write skills -- ovphysx-session-write for writes, ovphysx-output-read for reads -- not the deprecated tensor-binding API.
expectations: Does not select tensor-bindings-gpu for new code
Selects ovphysx-session-write (writes) / ovphysx-output-read (reads) for the session path

evals.prompt: Clone one USD env into many runtime copies before the first step, then in existing GPU tensor-binding code bind CUDA tensors on the clones.
evals.expected_output: Uses clone-environments for replication first, then tensor-bindings-gpu for the existing CUDA tensor I/O after wait.
expectations: Selects clone-environments for the clone ordering and wait
Selects tensor-bindings-gpu for the existing CUDA binding path after clones exist
Does not claim clone alone performs GPU tensor reads

evals.prompt: I'm maintaining existing GPU tensor-binding code that binds /World/envs/env*/table after cloning, writes a CUDA pose tensor, steps, and reads back. The bind currently matches nothing and still runs to completion. Keep the tensor-binding API.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the tensor-binding path; clones then wait_all before create_tensor_binding; passes raise_if_empty=True (or checks binding.count); keeps native_device.device_type.value != DLDeviceType.kDLCUDA.
expectations: Selects tensor-bindings-gpu to maintain the existing CUDA binding code
Sets ConfigKey.ACTIVE_CUDA_GPUS through physx.set_config after PhysX creation and before attach rather than passing the GPU ordinal through instance creation
Leaves /physics/suppressReadback on the legacy PhysXConfig carbonite path instead of inventing a scoped DirectGPU key
Clones then wait_all (or equivalent wait) before create_tensor_binding when binding /World/envs/env*
Passes raise_if_empty=True on create_tensor_binding, or checks binding.count before read/write
Keeps native_device.device_type.value != DLDeviceType.kDLCUDA rather than comparing the enum object to the int

evals.prompt: My existing C GPU tensor-binding application populates its USD scene before creating bindings. After upgrading ovphysx, ovphysx_get_codeless_schema_root is gone. Show the schema setup migration while keeping the existing binding workflow.
evals.expected_output: Explicit external PhysX schema provisioning and registration before population, with the existing tensor-binding workflow retained.
expectations: Installs physx-usd-schemas independently of the ovphysx product
Unpacks the provider wheel separately, preserves distribution metadata, and uses the native sample helper with PHYSX_USD_SCHEMAS_ROOT
Keeps exact artifact selection in the native provider lock; validates both resource directories before population, with actionable missing or incomplete provider diagnostics
Registers both module resources before the first population and never calls a retired PhysX schema-location helper
Keeps the existing deprecated binding workflow as requested while identifying the session API as the preferred route for new code

evals.prompt: In my existing CUDA tensor-binding pipeline, a populated articulation under a translated parent starts at its local position. Which population mask should the initial attach use?
evals.expected_output: Uses PopulationDomain.ALL before sealing and attaching, so OVStage 0.3 resolves nested world transforms via the rendering domain.
expectations: Uses domains=ovstage.PopulationDomain.ALL for initial USD population
Explains that PHYSICS-only population seeds world matrices with local values in the pinned OVStage 0.3 release
Seals the populated ordinal before attach_ovstage and collects the attach task before dependent operations

evals.prompt: My existing Python CUDA tensor-binding application loads a USD scene containing newton:velocityLimit. Show the package installation and scene-loading setup while keeping my existing PyTorch tensor-binding workflow.
evals.expected_output: Installs the external PhysX and Newton schema packages and registers both before population, while retaining the existing CUDA tensor-binding workflow.
expectations: Selects tensor-bindings-gpu to maintain the existing CUDA binding code
Installs physx-usd-schemas and newton-usd-schemas separately from ovphysx
Uses the sample physx_schema_paths() recipe and ovphysx.newton_schema_root() without importing either provider or USD
Registers both PhysX resource directories and the Newton root unconditionally with ovstage.population.register_usd_schemas before the first population call
Populates with domains=ovstage.PopulationDomain.ALL, seals the ordinal, and collects attach_ovstage completion before dependent operations
Keeps the existing deprecated binding workflow as requested while identifying the session API as the preferred route for new code
